findings.title: Invoice lookup queries by primary key without tenant scope
findings.remediation: Include tenantId from the verified auth session in the query predicate: where: { id: req.params.id, tenantId: session.tenantId }.

findings.title: Overly permissive CORS origin configuration
findings.evidence: corsMiddleware configured with broad origin reflection
findings.remediation: Replace broad origin matching with an explicit allowlist of trusted application origins.
